purpose: Signals that were researched or measured for this project and rejected as a basis for direction. Used by the supplied-thesis check in stage 2 and by the thesis checklist and the critic in stage 4. A match is a flag, never a block.
matching: Case-insensitive regular expressions, tested against the thesis basis and the text of each cited finding.

signals.name: Unusual options flow
signals.reason: Large or unusual option trades did not give a usable signal of direction at retail scale. Factor specification, section 10.

signals.name: Implied-volatility rank as a cheap or expensive verdict
signals.reason: Where implied volatility sits in its own past range does not show that options are cheap or expensive. Factor specification, section 10.

signals.name: Put/call ratio, skew or put-call parity as direction
signals.reason: These option-market readings did not give a usable signal of direction. Factor specification, section 10.

signals.name: Dealer gamma exposure
signals.reason: Estimates of dealer positioning available to a retail user are unreliable and did not predict direction. Factor specification, section 10.

signals.name: Max pain
signals.reason: The price at which most options expire worthless did not predict where the stock closes. Factor specification, section 10.

signals.name: Chart patterns and candlesticks
signals.reason: Named chart and candlestick patterns are display only in this system and may not support a direction. Factor specification, section 9b.

signals.name: Fibonacci and Elliott wave
signals.reason: Display only in this system; not accepted as support for a direction. Factor specification, section 9b.

signals.name: Agreement across timeframes
signals.reason: Counting how many timeframes agree adds no information beyond the trend itself. Timeframes are shown side by side and never combined.

signals.name: Price trend or momentum as direction
signals.reason: Measured 16 November 2026 on 20 years of prices for 105 names: trend shifted the chance of closing higher by under a point, in the mean-reverting direction, and not consistently for any one name. Trend is description only.

signals.name: Support or resistance as a reason for direction
signals.reason: Chart levels are description only. They were withdrawn as a basis for direction and for exits on 17 November 2026: their definition is arbitrary and nothing measured shows that they hold.

signals.name: Social media sentiment
signals.reason: Sentiment on social platforms did not give a usable signal of direction. Factor specification, section 10.

signals.name: Institutional holdings filings
signals.reason: Quarterly holdings filings are months old when published and did not give a usable signal. Factor specification, section 10.

signals.name: Accounting accruals
signals.reason: The accruals effect did not survive as a usable signal in liquid names. Factor specification, section 10.

signals.name: Sector rotation or industry momentum
signals.reason: Sector rotation and industry momentum did not add a usable signal. Sector evidence may qualify a view; it may not start one. Factor specification, sections 9c and 10.
